findings.text: BT185_DatabaseOptimization.test.js only calls the exported helper updateExistingJobsBatched directly with a mock client. No assertion exercises runStuttgartShootoutAndIngest, so reverting the call site (scripts/ingest-stuttgart-tier4.js line ~326) to the old per-row .update().eq('id') loop would still pass every test.

The BT172 index parity test (line 46) compares schema.sql to live-index-snapshot-2026-09-22.json, but that snapshot was hand-edited to add idx_jobs_status_last_checked, so it is a pin and not a live read. No test checks that migration_bt185_composite_indexes.sql agrees with schema.sql, so the AC wording 'matches live migration catalog' is unverified.

idx_companies_status_last_checked is covered only by the new BT172 it() (indexdef contains 'status, last_checked_at NULLS FIRST'). It is not added to any snapshot pin, and the migration file creating it is never asserted against schema.sql. The check is existence plus a substring match.
